translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: FILIPENSES
book.title: An u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Filipos c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: A Cristo in tsa’ca’ tim ba’ ani pithan in eylabil c’athpich pulic

U le’ cu tso’obna’ max chubax ti lubachmethanchal a ichich a Cristo. Hualam max chubax ti culbethanchal a ichich. Hualam max chubax a co’onchal i t’ilomtalab c’al an Espíritu Santo. Hualam max chubax a c’anithal ani a let’enthal a ebchalchic c’al a Cristo.
Max lej chubaxits, tamna’ nan ne’ets quin jum putat culbe c’al an juncuthtalab ani an c’anithomtalab ax a cua’al jun c’al xi jun. Ne’ets quin lej culbe cum a ne’thalchic a ichich ts’ot’c’óthlithits.
Jaxtam yab ca co’oy i ts’e’netalab ta ichich. Ca co’oy tsa’at a ichich ani yab ca t’aja’ c’athat ta ichich. Yab ca tsalpay abal tata’ it más lej alhua’ ani axi q’ue’atchic iba.
Yab ca xija’ ta ba’ abal expith tata’ ca huat’a’ alhua’. Ca luba’ ca tolmiy axi q’ue’atchic abal quin huat’a’ jaye alhua’.
Ca lej alhua’ pena’ ta ichich in tsalap a Cristo Jesús.
Aba ani’ in t’ajtal ey jaja’ pelits a Dios, bel yab in xija’ tim ba’ ca puhuethanchat im bij ti Dios.
In hualba’ tim ba’ ani hua’tsin ti inic. In t’aja’ ti t’ojnal c’al a Dios teje’ tsabal.
Xe’tsin exlab in ey pel i inic jaye. C’al in ichich tsa’at ets’ey im putumal c’al in uchbil c’al a Dios, ma im bina’ tim ba’ ca tsemtha ti al an cruz ejtil tu tsemthab ti jayq’ui’ i pojcax inic.
Cum a Jesús antsana’ in tala’ putumal c’al in uchbil, jaxtam a Dios im pitha’ in eylabil más t’ec’at axi hua’ats. Yab hua’ats jita’ lej c’athpich pulic im bij ejtil im bij a Jesús ca c’ac’nanchat.
Pel in uchbil tim patal an ejattalab tam ca olnanchat im bij a Jesús quin c’ac’nanchi. Ma an ángelchic ani an inicchic ani an teneclabchic tim patal quin c’ac’nanchi.
Tim patalchic quin olna’ abal a Jesucristo ja’its an Ajatic. Antsana’ ne’ets ca puhuethanchat im bij a Dios jaye tam ca olnanchat ani ca c’ac’nanchat im bij a Jesucristo.
Tajbaxnanchix ax im belal a Cristo

C’an ebchalabchic, a putumal c’al jahua’ nan tu exobchi in cahuintal a Dios tam tin c’uajatac c’al tata’chic ti jayq’ui’. Xohue’ biyat yab in c’uajat, más ca putu. Cum it jec’onthachitschic, ca lej luba’ ca c’ac’na’ a Dios ani ca putu c’al a uchbil jant’ini’ tin le’ a Dios.
Cum ja’its a Dios ax u t’ojnal ta ichich abal ca le’nanchi ani ca t’ajchi in alhua’ culbetal.
Ni hue’ yab quit xe’tsin c’al a ichich toc’oc’ol ani jolbibil.

Tam ni jita’ yab ne’ets ti elchi jant’o c’al ti jolbiy. Cum pel ti tsacamilchic a Dios, quit xe’tsin c’al a ichich bolith ani yab ca hualca’ quit ts’ilc’onchat c’al jahua’ yab bolith. Cum hua’ats teje’ al an hualab c’ay’lal yantalam i inic c’al in ichich yab chubax ani yab bolith. Ca tajbaxnanchi in tajax a Cristo c’al jaja’chic ejtil ti tajbax a otchic c’al an yic’uax.

Ca olnaxnanchichic in cahuintal a Dios c’al ca it ejatliyat. Max antsana’ ta ca t’aja’chic, tam ojni’ ne’ets quin lej culbe tam ca chich a Cristo tin ebal abal a lej putumal c’al in cahuintal a Dios axi nan tu exobchichic. Cu exla’ abal yab jolat nan u ejtohuamal tu tolmiychic tin cuenta a ejattal.

Ne’ets quin culbe aba ma quin tsemtha, cum ne’ets cu bina’ tu ba’ c’al a Dios ejtil max nan in ts’acchixtalab. Tata’chic a belamal a Dios ani a binamalits a ichich ejtil ti ts’acchixtalab c’al a Dios. Cum i junax belamal a Cristo ani i junax t’ojonchal, jaxtam cu lej junax culbe.
Jant’ini’ nan in culbel, antsana’ quit culbetechic.
A Timoteo ani a Epafrodito
Max pel in culbetal an Ajatic Jesús u le’ cu thubat aba’ a Timoteo ca c’ale ti tsa’biychic. U le’ac tam ca huichiy max quin ejtou tiquin olchi abal it lej juncuthchic, ani antsana’ quin lej culbe.
Ni jita’ yab hua’ats ejtil a Timoteo lej canat ti tolmiychic abal ca huat’a’chic alhua’ tin cuenta a ejattal.
Jelat jat’hua’ patal an inicchic expith canat ti cuenta in cuete’ culbetal, ani iba in le’ quin t’ajchi in culbetal a Cristo Jesús.

A alhua’ exlanchalits in ey a Timoteo, cum in tejhua’methalits tim ba’ abal lej pututh c’al in culbetal a Cristo Jesús. Jant’ini’ ti tolmix i tsacamlab c’al in tata, antsana’ a Timoteo tin tolmiyamal nana’ cu olna’ an alhua’ cau.
Tam cu tso’obna’its jant’o ne’ets quin t’ajchin teje’ al an huic’axte’, tamna’its ne’ets cu aba’ a Timoteo ca c’ale ti tsa’biychic.
U aychal max pel in culbetal an Ajatic quim baju an hora tam quin c’alene tu tsa’biychic.

Tata’chic tin abchi a Epafrodito abal tiquin tolmiy teje’ al an huic’axte’, ani xo’ u tsalpayal abal alhua’ ca huichiy c’al tata’chic. Tin tolminchamal jaja’ c’al u t’ojlabil c’al an Ajatic. Ejtil max pel tu at soldado c’al a Cristo.
Lej canat in ichich in le’ ti tsu’u ta patalchic, ani xo’ te c’uajat lej t’e’pith cum in tso’obnamalits abal it olchinenecchic abal jaja’ u ya’ulac.

Ani lej chubax u ya’ulac, ma hue’its ne’ets ca tsemets. Cum lej yajnanchat c’al a Dios, jaxtam xo’ jelthachits. Ejtil max a Dios tin yajnanchine abal yab quin huat’ath t’e’pin max ca tsemetsac a Epafrodito.
U lej le’ cu aba’ ca huichiy c’al tata’chic abal quit culbechic tam ca tsu’chi in hual. Ne’ets quin culbene tam cu tso’obna’ abal it junax culbenecchic c’al jaja’.
Ca lej alhua’ bats’u c’al a culbetal, cum pel it at ebchalabchic c’al an Ajatic. Ca lej ets’ey c’ac’na’ jaja’ a Epafrodito ani tim patal an ebchalabchic ax in ey ejtil jaja’.

Ca lej c’ac’na’, cum hue’its ca tsemets c’al yan i t’ojlab in t’ajamal c’al a Cristo. In mo’camal in cuete’ q’uijlabil abal tiquin tolminchi c’al u t’ojlabil tam tata’chic yab a ejtohuamal tiquin tolmiy.
